en: From trail sessions to après-ski meetups, PeakUp is where coaches and athletes find each other — in the places they already love to move.
Real people. Real sessions. Real destinations.
Join a premium multisport network built for independent certified coaches, instructors, and guides.
Grow your visibility, bookings, and business
PeakUp connects athletes and travelers with trusted local coaches for authentic sports experiences worldwide.
A way to experience the world.
We connect passionate athletes with world-class coaches through a trusted, cinematic experience — from discovery to booking to the moment you show up ready to perform.
Train where the world opens up
Sport deserves a platform as ambitious as the people who live it
Discover PeakUp — the premium sports coaching marketplace built for athletes and coaches.
Book coaches across destinations — mountain, ocean, court, and city.
Tools that help coaches build reputation, fill sessions, and scale.
Curated experiences with transparent profiles, reviews, and pricing.
Every coach profile is reviewed so athletes book with confidence.
Generic marketplaces weren’t built for sport. PeakUp was — for coaches who teach at the edge and athletes who chase progress.
Cinematic discovery designed for sport, not classified ads
Booking flows tuned for sessions, seasons, and destinations
Because performance needs a better stage
Yoga at sunrise, recovery by the water, coaching woven into travel — PeakUp helps athletes book experiences that feel as intentional as the training itself.
Recovery and retreat, built into the journey
